category_title: Adult students with high statistics anxiety and low math self-efficacy
minimal_context: The student is reviewing the published course description and math requirements on the first night of the business statistics class.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Welcome to the first night of our business statistics course. Please take a look at the published course description and the math requirements we will be covering this semester.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Looking at this syllabus... honestly, the idea of taking statistics scared me to death. Just knowing I had to take this course, it stressed me out before I even walked in the door.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's just go through the requirements. What do you think about the algebra prerequisites listed here?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I just don't get it. I've never enjoyed math, and seeing all these equations makes me feel completely overwhelmed.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You just need to keep trying. Let's start by reviewing the basic math concepts on the first page.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I have a significant fear of math courses because of my challenges with basic math. I passed college-level algebra the third time I took it, and I know someone who had to take college algebra five times just to pass. I really don't think I can do this.
